binding.subject: server authenticated bootstrap enrollment or worker credential; must own body.workerId
binding.issuance: Lease response credential binds workerId, leaseId and expiresAt exactly; expiration is at most 300 seconds from issue and never beyond approved bootstrap enrollment.
binding.renewal: Heartbeat verifies worker.self, audience, current lease, revocation and expiry before renewal; rotate token, revoke replaced token, never extend enrollment or capability scope.
binding.replay: Recheck current authorization before replay; an expired or revoked token result is not renewed by replay. Use a fresh key and current identity; expired worker identity re-registers via bootstrap.
